primary_crosses_three_day_window.interpretation: All three headline associations remain confidence-interval positive when the drier survey lies outside the NAAMP 0-3 day rain-target window.

secondary_both_outside_three_day_window.interpretation: All three point estimates remain positive when both surveys lie outside the 0-3 day window, but local alpha and gamma are imprecise in the much smaller subset; this diagnostic is not a PASS criterion.

authorized_conclusion: The RC7 multiscale association is not confined to comparisons entirely within the NAAMP 0-3 day protocol-target window. This does not eliminate scheduling selection or establish rainfall causality.
prohibited: the both-outside subset proves persistence at long lags
